boq_revisions_template_assignment_consis.name: boq_revisions_template_assignment_consistent

design_jobs_deadline_consistent.name: design_jobs_deadline_consistent

quotation_revisions_payment_split_valid.name: quotation_revisions_payment_split_valid
quotation_revisions_payment_split_valid.value: ("quotation_revisions"."cash_percentage" is null and "quotation_revisions"."non_cash_percentage" is null) or ("quotation_revisions"."cash_percentage" between 0 and 100 and "quotation_revisions"."non_cash_percentage" between 0 and 100 and "quotation_revisions"."cash_percentage" + "quotation_revisions"."non_cash_percentage" = 100)

quotation_revisions_submission_consisten.name: quotation_revisions_submission_consistent
quotation_revisions_submission_consisten.value: ("quotation_revisions"."status" = 'draft' and "quotation_revisions"."submitted_at" is null and "quotation_revisions"."submitted_by_user_id" is null) or ("quotation_revisions"."status" <> 'draft' and "quotation_revisions"."submitted_at" is not null and "quotation_revisions"."submitted_by_user_id" is not null)

quotation_revisions_approval_consistent.name: quotation_revisions_approval_consistent
quotation_revisions_approval_consistent.value: "quotation_revisions"."status" in ('draft', 'submitted', 'returned') or ("quotation_revisions"."approved_at" is not null and "quotation_revisions"."approved_by_user_id" is not null)

quotation_revisions_issue_consistent.name: quotation_revisions_issue_consistent
